extracted.name: Banana Pandesal
ingredient_lines: 2 1/4 cups Bread flour/All purpose flour/plain flour
instruction_lines: Mashed the bananas. Add the yeast, milk, melted butter and salt and mix. Add flour and mix until all the flour is incorporated.

Place it in a bowl and let it sit in a warm place for one hour. Take it out of the bowl and place it on a mixing table and knead to make a long oval shape. Cut it in have and shape the half into a ball.
Flatten the ball and cut it into 8 parts. Do the same to the other half. Take the small parts and form it into a ball.
Grease two pans with butter. Place 8 pieces in each pan and cover it with plastic and let it sit for about 50 minutes. Brush the top with some milk or egg wash.
Place the pans in a flat baking sheet. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake for 22 minutes. After 22 minutes, take it out of the oven and brush the top with butter. Let it cool and share and serve.
